title: Conjugate-orbit indexed tower BSGS with exact 41-percent success coverage

claims.statement: For the full protected fixed-G1 pairing inversion problem, the conjugate-orbit algorithm in proof.md returns a valid G2 preimage for exactly L/r of prescribed uniform targets, where m=39*2^121 and L=m*(2m-1), rigorously greater than 0.39. Total cold classical computation, including failed searches, all preprocessing, pairings, output and verification, is at most 2^132 dense-Fp12 reference equivalents at C=20000. Peak memory is below 2^145 bytes; preprocessing below 2^132 equivalents is included in total; nonuniform advice is zero bytes. This is an analytical upper bound, not a practical production attack.
